title: Run HO19 / Winflo Shield window rendering

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Recompose a campaign for its display setting because a large window changes the relationship between text and imagery.
strategic_value: Moving the Winflo copy onto the photograph can let the activity fill the shop window while preserving product identification.
demonstration: The window rendering expands the runner and shoe inset across the display; white copy sits over the image rather than in the separate left column of NS12.
practical_value: Compare the window execution with the flat layout to judge text contrast and retained image relationships.

content_islands.name: Window composition
content_islands.spec: Fill the recessed display with the running image and larger shoe inset at right.

content_islands.name: Overlay information
content_islands.spec: Place white product text and a solid Swoosh at upper left; retain the large outline Swoosh across the photographs.

content_islands.name: Storefront frame
content_islands.spec: Keep the surrounding dark facade, pavement and partial store entrance visible.

reference_purposes.Application: The window rendering expands the runner and shoe inset across the display; white copy sits over the image rather than in the separate left column of NS12.
